shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Not controlled by another person or organisation.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: အမှီအခိုကင်းသော၊ လွတ်လပ်သော
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The team made an independent decision.

records.editorial_diagnosis: Cambridge labels freedom from outside influence/control B2; its B1 NEED sense concerns not relying on help. The draft's 'independent decision' depicts influence/control rather than self-sufficiency.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Seek a B1 self-sufficiency rewrite only if independently validated; otherwise replace or retier without altering quotas.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A strong effect that something has on a situation.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: သက်ရောက်မှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The new policy had an impact on small businesses.

records.editorial_diagnosis: Cambridge Learner's Dictionary labels the strong-effect noun sense B2; the policy-impact example uses this effect sense. The separate physical-force sense is also B2 in that source.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Obtain a publisher-backed B1 exact sense from another reliable source or replace/retier; do not infer B1 from context.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The business of selling goods directly to customers.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: လက်လီရောင်းချမှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: She has worked in retail for five years.

records.editorial_diagnosis: Cambridge labels the uncountable retail-business noun C1; the provisional retail-sector definition and worked-in-retail example illustrate this sense.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Check for a genuine B2 source-supported sense; otherwise choose an independently sourced B2 replacement or retier.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Refusal to accept or support a change or action.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: ခုခံဆန့်ကျင်မှု
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The proposal met resistance from local residents.

records.editorial_diagnosis: Cambridge labels opposition/refusal noun sense C2. The draft's 'proposal met resistance' matches opposition; other dictionary sources may assign another level, so this is a conflict lead not proof of error.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Compare another primary CEFR sense source and obtain independent B2 evidence, or replace/retier.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: The qualities of character that make a person different from others.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: ကိုယ်ရည်ကိုယ်သွေး
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Her friendly personality helps her make new friends.

records.editorial_diagnosis: Cambridge labels the character/behaviour noun sense B2, consistent with the draft's friendly-personality example; separate famous-person sense is also labelled B2.
records.independent_reviewer_task: Independent English, Myanmar and example review is still required; confirm CHARACTER sense rather than FAMOUS PERSON.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: Relating to a city or town and its local government.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: စည်ပင်သာယာရေးဆိုင်ရာ၊ မြို့အုပ်ချုပ်ရေးဆိုင်ရာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: The municipal council approved the new park.

records.editorial_diagnosis: Cambridge labels the city/town adjective sense C1, matching the municipal-council context; the label is publisher source evidence, not independent signoff.
